svg.aria-label: The weighing of the pull request. After the Papyrus of Ani: Anubis kneels at the scales, a heavy pull request of 4,812 added lines sinks against the feather labelled LGTM, Thoth writes: changes requested, and Ammit waits beside him. The hieroglyphs above are braces, coffee cups, scarab bugs, floppy disks and git branches.

g.text: Plate V. After the Papyrus of Ani, Book of the Dead, c. 1250 BC.
THE WEIGHING OF THE PULL REQUEST.
I'm Lei Kai, a senior full-stack engineer and architect in Xianyang, China.
Since 2017 I've built products end to end, from the database to the last pixel.
Every pull request I review is weighed against a feather. Kindly.
